## Ingredients

### Sliders

- 1 lb ground chicken
- 12 slider buns
- 2 cups oil for the griddle {{no-scale}}
- 1/2 cup blue cheese dip {{component:test-blue-cheese-dip}}

### To serve

- Celery sticks & carrot sticks (100% optional)

## Instructions

1. Form 12 patties and cook until done.
2. Spoon the **dip** over each slider and serve.
